quests.instruction: Scan the sentence for the exact appointment time.
quests.passage: The dentist appointment is scheduled for three fifteen on Wednesday afternoon.
quests.hint: Look for the more precise time, not just the hour.
quests.explanation: The appointment is at three fifteen; 'three' alone is not the exact time given.

quests.instruction: Search the sentence for the third color listed.
quests.passage: The new phone comes in black, silver, and rose gold colors.
quests.hint: Count the colors in order and find the last one named.
quests.explanation: The colors are listed in order, and rose gold is the third one mentioned.

quests.instruction: Scan the sentence for the room number.
quests.passage: Room 214 is reserved for the finance team's weekly meeting.
quests.hint: Search for the number that names the room.
quests.explanation: The reserved room is 214; the other words describe the meeting, not the room.

quests.instruction: Scan the sentence for the first-hour parking rate.
quests.passage: The parking garage charges four dollars for the first hour and two dollars for each additional hour.
quests.hint: Find the price connected to the first hour, not later hours.
quests.explanation: The first hour costs four dollars; two dollars applies only to extra hours.

quests.instruction: Search the sentence for where practice moved to.
quests.passage: Coach Liu moved practice from the gym to the outdoor field because of a scheduling conflict.
quests.hint: Look for the new location, not the old one.
quests.explanation: Practice moved to the outdoor field; the gym was only the previous location.

quests.instruction: Scan the sentence for the invoice number.
quests.passage: The invoice number 7734 must be included on every payment.
quests.hint: Search for the number that identifies the invoice.
quests.explanation: The invoice number is 7734; the rest of the sentence explains what to do with it.

quests.instruction: Scan both sentences to find when bread was no longer available.
quests.passage: The bakery sold out of croissants by nine. Bread was still available until noon.
quests.hint: Look in the second sentence for the time bread ran out.
quests.explanation: Croissants sold out by nine, but bread lasted until noon.

quests.instruction: Search the sentence for how long the delay lasted.
quests.passage: Flight 220 was delayed by forty minutes because of weather.
quests.hint: Find the number of minutes, not the flight number.
quests.explanation: The delay lasted forty minutes; 220 only identifies the flight.

quests.instruction: Scan the sentence to find the correct aisle number.
quests.passage: The hardware store keeps extra nails in aisle six, not aisle three.
quests.hint: Watch for two aisle numbers and pick the one that is correct.
quests.explanation: Extra nails are in aisle six; aisle three is mentioned only to rule it out.

quests.instruction: Search the sentence for when Pilates starts.
quests.passage: Yoga class meets at seven in the morning, while Pilates meets at four in the evening.
quests.hint: Look for the time linked to Pilates, not Yoga.
quests.explanation: Yoga meets at seven; Pilates, the second class named, meets at four.

quests.instruction: Scan the sentence for the clinic's closing time.
quests.passage: The clinic's pharmacy closes at five, though the main clinic stays open until eight.
quests.hint: Find the time for the main clinic, not the pharmacy.
quests.explanation: The pharmacy closes at five, but the main clinic stays open until eight.

quests.instruction: Search for the ticket price charged at the door.
quests.passage: Ticket prices are twelve dollars online and fifteen dollars at the door.
quests.hint: Look for the price connected to buying at the door, not online.
quests.explanation: Online tickets cost twelve dollars; fifteen dollars is the door price.

quests.instruction: Scan the sentence for the book's due date.
quests.passage: The library book is due back on the ninth, but can be renewed once for free.
quests.hint: Search for the number that tells the due date.
quests.explanation: The due date is the ninth; renewing once is a separate detail.

quests.instruction: Find the second day of Ms. Patel's office hours.
quests.passage: Ms. Patel's office hours are Tuesdays and Thursdays from two to four.
quests.hint: Look for the day named after Tuesdays.
quests.explanation: Office hours run on both days, but Thursdays is the second day listed.

quests.instruction: Scan the recipe for the amount of cinnamon.
quests.passage: The recipe calls for half a teaspoon of cinnamon and a full teaspoon of nutmeg.
quests.hint: Search for the amount placed right before cinnamon.
quests.explanation: Cinnamon needs half a teaspoon; a full teaspoon is for the nutmeg.

quests.instruction: Scan the sentence for the more experienced candidate's name.
quests.passage: Two candidates applied for the position: Daniela Cruz and Marcus Webb. Daniela has more years of experience.
quests.hint: Search the second sentence for whose experience is greater.
quests.explanation: Both candidates are named, but the second sentence confirms Daniela Cruz has more experience.

quests.instruction: Search the sentence for the cost of Saturday swim lessons.
quests.passage: The community center offers free swim lessons on Saturdays and paid yoga classes on Sundays.
quests.hint: Look for the word describing the Saturday activity's cost.
quests.explanation: Swim lessons on Saturdays are free; the paid classes are yoga on Sundays.

quests.instruction: Scan the sentence for the elevator's expected finish day.
quests.passage: Repairs to the elevator will begin Monday and are expected to finish by Friday.
quests.hint: Find the day the repairs are expected to end, not begin.
quests.explanation: Repairs start Monday, but they are expected to finish by Friday.

quests.instruction: Scan the weather update for the expected temperature.
quests.passage: Weather Update: Rain is expected this morning, clearing by early afternoon. Temperatures will reach seventy degrees.
quests.hint: Search for the number tied to the word degrees.
quests.explanation: The update gives times for the rain, but seventy is the temperature figure.

quests.instruction: Search the memo for when the holiday party starts.
quests.passage: Staff Memo: The office will close early on Friday for a holiday party starting at three.
quests.hint: Look for the time near the word starting.
quests.explanation: The office closes early on Friday, and the party itself starts at three.

quests.instruction: Scan the delivery notice for the estimated arrival window.
quests.passage: Delivery Notice: Your package left the warehouse and should arrive within two business days.
quests.hint: Search for the number that tells how many days to expect.
quests.explanation: The notice estimates arrival within two business days after leaving the warehouse.

quests.instruction: Find the new number of treadmills at the gym.
quests.passage: The gym added new equipment last week. Members can now use five treadmills instead of the previous two.
quests.hint: Look for the number describing the current total, not the old one.
quests.explanation: The gym previously had two treadmills; it now has five.

quests.instruction: Scan both parts of the sentence for the trip's new month.
quests.passage: The school trip was originally planned for April but was moved to May because of the holiday.
quests.hint: Search for the month the trip was changed to, not the original one.
quests.explanation: The trip was first planned for April, then moved to May.

quests.instruction: Search the sentence for today's sign-up bonus.
quests.passage: Customers who join today receive a free tote bag; those who join next month will not.
quests.hint: Look for the reward connected to joining today.
quests.explanation: Joining today comes with a free tote bag; joining next month does not.

quests.instruction: Scan the sentence for the current support number.
quests.passage: For support, call 555-0148, not the old number 555-0114.
quests.hint: Watch for two similar numbers and pick the current one.
quests.explanation: 555-0148 is the current number; 555-0114 is named only as the old one.

quests.instruction: Search the sentence for the length of the grace period.
quests.passage: The rent is due on the first of the month, with a five-day grace period after that.
quests.hint: Look for the number of days allowed after the due date.
quests.explanation: Rent is due on the first, and tenants get a five-day grace period afterward.

quests.instruction: Scan the sentence for the online order deadline.
quests.passage: The bookstore's clearance sale ends Sunday, though online orders are accepted through Tuesday.
quests.hint: Find the day tied specifically to online orders.
quests.explanation: The in-store sale ends Sunday, but online orders are accepted through Tuesday.

quests.instruction: Scan the sentence for the Finance session's start time.
quests.passage: The conference has three sessions: Marketing at nine, Finance at eleven, and Design at two.
quests.hint: Search for the time listed right after the word Finance.
quests.explanation: Finance starts at eleven; nine and two belong to Marketing and Design.

quests.instruction: Search the sentence for the pet-friendly unit.
quests.passage: Of the four apartments for rent, only unit 3B allows pets.
quests.hint: Look for the unit number connected to allowing pets.
quests.explanation: Unit 3B is the one that allows pets, out of the four available.

quests.instruction: Scan the sentence for the mile marker at City Hall.
quests.passage: The marathon route passes Elm Park at mile two, City Hall at mile five, and finishes at mile thirteen near the stadium.
quests.hint: Search for the mile number placed next to City Hall.
quests.explanation: City Hall is at mile five; the other numbers mark Elm Park and the finish.
